summary: postinstall fetches and executes binary from hardcoded bare-IP endpoint with TLS verification disabled
details: The npm postinstall hook in @onescience/onecode downloads a platform-specific tgz from a hardcoded bare-IP URL (https://218.90.133.98:4443/onecode_tgz/), extracts it into node_modules, chmods the binary executable (0o755), and hardlinks it as bin/.onecode which is invoked by the CLI. The fetch is performed with rejectUnauthorized:false, disabling TLS certificate validation, and no hash or signature verification is applied to the downloaded bytes. The delivery endpoint is a bare IPv4 address rather than the publisher's documented domain, is not tied to the npm registry or a publisher-owned host, and is fully mutable by whoever controls that address. Every install of this version runs whatever code that endpoint currently serves, and the disabled TLS validation additionally exposes the install-time payload to substitution by any on-path network attacker.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
